author: Fran Churchill Harriman
text: Grandma’s remedy to remove anything stuck under the skin was to try tweezers first. If that didn’t work, cut a piece of bacon fat and bandage it over the splinter for 24 hours. The splinter and anything under the skin (dirt, pus, etc) came right out. Wash well with soap and water and you should be good to go.
